experiment.name: planner-tier-bench
experiment.question: Holding QA persona model constant (Gemini-flash-lite), swap PLANNER from baseline Gemini-flash-lite to Gemini-3-flash-preview / Claude-Haiku-4-5 / Azure gpt-5.4-mini. Which is worth shipping?
experiment.metric: 6-dim 0-3 Likert total per case, max 18; grand mean across cases
experiment.threshold_rule: Aggregate Δ ≥ 1.4pt (= max(1pt, 2× within-arm stddev 0.70pt from PR #13))
experiment.trials_per_arm: baseline = 3 trials (reused from PR #13); A1/A2/A3 = 1 trial each + Gemini-3.5-flash cross-judge on all 4 dev

variance_trials._note: Reused from PR #13. Within-arm trial-to-trial mean stddev = 0.70pt → 1.4pt threshold.

dev_set_aggregate_gemini_cross_judge._note: Gemini-3.5-flash judge on the same 11 dev cases. A2 direction FLIPS vs Opus (0.88 Opus → -0.82 Gemini) — Opus self-judging bias on Anthropic family suspected.

cross_judge_sanity._a2_note: Opus says 0.88 vs baseline; Gemini says -0.82. Strong evidence Opus over-rates Anthropic-family outputs.

verdict.rationale: All 3 candidates net negative on TEST (A1 -0.38, A2 -1.88, A3 -0.62). A2 was the only arm that looked positive on dev under Opus (0.88) but cross-judge sanity caught self-judging bias, AND test confirmed catastrophic regression. Empathy slice cratered (-5.0 vs baseline) for A2. None clears the 1.4pt threshold; A2 EXCEEDS it in the wrong direction on test. Planner-tier swap is not the right lever for this rubric on this prompt.
